title: J. Matt Baker
intro:
J. Matt Baker (independent) is running for election to the U.S. House to represent Virginia's 2nd Congressional District. He is on the ballot in the general election on November 3, 2026.
Baker completed Ballotpedia's Candidate Connection survey in 2026. Click here to read the survey answers.
